rows.text: Something weird happened to the nymphs in the Abyss of Fate... it seems to be caused by Oronyx's power
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: This means all the nymphs there have been collected
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Please, remember to check out the Garmentmaker over there, esteemed guest
rows.speaker: Aglaea
